result.reason: The redline reaches at least the fallback and substantially reaches the preferred position: it adds a mutual aggregate cap based on 12 months of amounts paid or payable, subject to a USD 1 million floor, and includes all specified uncapped carve-outs. It preserves the existing mutual consequential-damages exclusion and unrelated commercial intent. However, it omits the preferred clarification that Customer payment obligations are not damages subject to the cap. Drafting could also be improved by using “fees paid or payable” rather than the broader and potentially ambiguous “amounts paid or payable between the parties,” and by defining Excluded Claims as liabilities arising from the listed matters rather than referring awkwardly to obligations as claims.
